        for k in k_values:

        print(f"    seed={seed}: full={seed_results['full']:.4f}, k1={seed_results['k1']:.4f}, k2={seed_results['k2']:.4f}")

        del encoder, gru
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    if results["per_seed"]:
        metrics = ["k1", "k2", "k3", "k5", "full"]

            if vals:
